answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 41272 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to take hadia money for reciting the holy Quran in tarawih salah Question: Is it permissible to take hadia money for reciting the holy Quran in tarawih salah? Answer ID: 41272 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 822/805/N=1433) Whatever one takes on reciting the holy Quran in tarawih is not right as per the Shariah whether it is called compensation or gift. Both types of people who give and take shall be sinful and no one shall get any reward of reading and listening to the holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
